concept.title: Large Language Models (LLMs)
concept.body: An LLM is trained on vast text to predict the next word, which is what lets it draft, summarise, and reason over language. It generates plausible text rather than looking up facts — hence its fluency and its habit of confident mistakes ('hallucinations').
concept.takeaway: Lean on LLMs for drafting and synthesis, and keep a human check on high-stakes outputs.
